ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a localized high-intensity (white) region at the lower central margin, representing an approximate 95:5 dark-to-white ratio on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous dark-pigmented field. Small, isolated high-intensity white speckles (possible water droplets or scarring) are scattered across both lobes. A distinct, high-intensity white patch is visible at the inferior center, near the peduncle junction, partially occluded by water splash.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped notch with an internal angle calculated at approximately 125 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations (peaks <10 pixels) across the trailing edge. High-amplitude irregular topographic spikes are visible at both distal tips due to biological attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping from the median notch towards the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast multi-tonal (white, tan, and dark) pixel clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, fine-lined high-intensity diagonal streaks (approximately 45-degree orientation) visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive sessile organism colonization (barnacles) localized at the distal fluke tips; possible shallow rake marks or linear scratches on the right lobe.
